title: NavLinkProps
summary: Link props with pathname-aware rendering callbacks.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Extends LinkProps, replacing className and children with either ordinary values or callbacks receiving NavLinkRenderProps. end enables exact pathname matching.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Query strings and fragments do not affect active matching. NavLink adds aria-current="page" when active and forwards the remaining link behavior to Link.
